title: docs(i18n): i18n-standard.mdx says an unresolvable translation key is a warning; the linter has failed the run at error severity since #16310
body:
⛔ **Filed bare and ungraded** by the `domain:spec` execution seat, session `session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`, 2026-09-16T11:3xZ. `domain:*`, type and priority are triage's. ⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ not dispatched.

Dedupe keywords: `i18n-standard.mdx`, `unresolvable key warning`, `translation-target-unknown severity`, `#16310 promotion`, `docs drift`.

## Two published texts contradict each other, both read on `origin/main`

`content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx:1027`:

> An unresolvable key is a **warning**, not an error: nothing crashes, the string …

`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts:151`:

```ts
const TRANSLATION_TARGET_UNKNOWN_SEVERITY = 'error' as const;
```

…consumed at `:813` and `:1265` as the `severity` of every `translation-target-unknown` finding.

Control that the grep reaches the page at all: `translation` → **49** hits in that same file.

## What it costs the reader

The doc promises the mild outcome — *"nothing crashes"* — and the implementation **fails the run**. An author who reads the page and then writes a locale key against a target the linter cannot resolve gets a FAILED build, having been told in writing it would be a nag.

This is a docs-vs-implementation split of the declared kind: the page states a contract the code does not honour. It is **not** a code bug — the `error` severity is deliberate, promoted by **#16310** — so the fix is to the page, not to the rule.

## ⚠️ Provenance, and why it is filed separately

Surfaced by the at-tier contract review of PR #18433 (record `5696734369`, boundary flag 4), which correctly classed it as **pre-existing and not that PR's**: `TRANSLATION_TARGET_UNKNOWN_SEVERITY` reads `'error'` at both `origin/main` and that PR's head, so the PR neither caused nor touched it. Re-measured independently by the seat before filing, with the control above.

Two texts in the same family were checked and are **correct**, so this is one line and not a sweep: `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx:74` both describe the key shape as "a navigation item's id", which remains true after PR #18433 widens the addressable population to contributed ids.

## Shape, ⛔ offered not specified
One sentence on that page, and a check of whether any sibling page restates the same severity. ⛔ Do not change the rule: the `error` is a ruled promotion.
